limitations: Historical prototype evidence retains its original qualification; no ordinary POST or installed/runtime replay performed.

Source pins may overlap and their counts must not be summed as unique repository coverage.
Source changes after the pinned commit require delta review.
Architecture selections do not prove claims, legal facts, producer attestation, code acceptance or finding closure.
